items.title: John Fedchock interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, May 28, 2015
items.q: I’ve been working with him over the last six years now I guess.

ctx.x: Wycliffe [Gordon]? Yeah. That one spot and you could tell it’s him. Yeah he’s another guy with just a freaky set of chops. I mean technically he can go anywhere. And a lot of energy and a lot of air. Yeah. I’ve been working with him over the last six years now I guess. Every year in January I do this thing called the Jazz Cruise, which is an entire giant cruise ship dedicated entirely to jazz. No other entertainment on the boat. No Broadway shows, no silly whatever — someone making balloon animals. It’s all jazz…
Uh huh. Does your wife get to go on the cruise?
